Zaheer Khan Appointed CSK Head Coach for IPL 2027

Zaheer Khan has been appointed as the head coach of Chennai Super Kings (CSK) for the upcoming Indian Premier League (IPL) season in 2027. He will replace Stephen Fleming in the role. The decision was reportedly influenced by a suggestion from MS Dhoni, who advocated for a familiar face to take over the coaching responsibilities.
